acceptanceCriteria: Both harnesses pass complete structured close fields; acceptance artifacts retain validated close decision receipts; static wrappers fail closed when structured decision handling is removed; tri-language release documentation records the boundary; no source-build fallback or isolation boundary changes.
goal: Ensure both release acceptance harnesses and their static wrappers close governed Work Items with structured decision evidence, copy that receipt into acceptance artifacts, and reject missing or mismatched decision records.
intent: Bind post-release adopter acceptance to a complete structured Human Decision without weakening release truth or isolation proof.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Both release acceptance harnesses provide all structured Human Decision fields to the downloaded Runtime binary.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run both harness static wrappers and one public adopter plus one N-1 acceptance execution.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The copied close receipt is regular, repository-bound through its binding record, identity-matched, complete, and checksummed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect acceptance.json, copied close receipt, binding record, and SHA256SUMS from both harness executions.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Missing structured close arguments or decision validation markers cause static acceptance checks to fail closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run bash syntax, static acceptance wrappers, and documentation acceptance checks.
